headerDisplay: Aqara devices in HomeKit and Matter, driven locally over the hub's own protocol. The account is used to sign in and to list what you own; everything after that stays on your network.

password.title: Password
password.description: Sent as a hash encrypted with Aqara's own public key, and never stored: only the session token is kept.

region.title: Region
region.description: The region your Aqara account belongs to. The wrong one signs in but lists nothing.

hub.title: Hub
hub.description: Left empty, the hub is found on the network - which is the only reliable way, since the port it listens on changes every time it reboots.

adaptiveLighting.title: Adaptive lighting
adaptiveLighting.description: Let HomeKit move the colour temperature through the day on lamps that have both a dimmer and a colour temperature.

enableMatter.title: Publish over Matter
enableMatter.description: Publish the same devices over Matter as well, for Alexa, SmartThings and the rest. Needs Matter enabled on the Homebridge bridge this plugin runs in.
